claims: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche is replacing Pam Bondi as acting Attorney General.
Pam Bondi was removed by President Trump on April 2, 2026.
Todd Blanche is President Trump's former criminal defense lawyer.
President Trump praised Todd Blanche as a "very talented and respected Legal Mind".
Todd Blanche served as the No. 2 law enforcement official since March 2025.
President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Pam Bondi’s handling of Department of Justice files related to Jeffrey Epstein.
President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Pam Bondi’s perceived failure to prosecute political opponents.
Todd Blanche is the acting Attorney General.
Reports indicate that President Trump is considering EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin for a permanent replacement.
President Trump announced that Pam Bondi will transition to a new position in the private sector.
